contract-board-help: Routes other couriers posted. Take one, beat the record, and the route is credited to you. Finish any plain courier run to post your own.
contract-empty: No contracts yet. Deliver a package and post the first.
contract-error: Could not reach the contract board.
contract-failed: Contract failed — the clock ran out.
contract-record: New record: {{time}}. The route is yours.
contract-sign-in: Sign in to post contract times.
gallery-empty: Nothing published yet. Finish a chapter and share yours.
gallery-help: Stories other players published. Continue one with your own name and cast.
publish-dupe: This seed is already in the gallery.

publish-limit: You have published the maximum number of seeds.
publish-unsaved: This world is not saved yet. Play a little further, then try again.

signal-listen: Listen to whoever can see it
signal-wait-all: Wait until everyone is in place
signals-empty: Nobody has left a signal here yet.
signals-limit: You already left that one, or have left three here.
signals-sign-in-leave: Sign in to leave a signal.
storm-custom-note: Training mode: unranked, and your score is never submitted.
storm-training-over: Training storm: unranked, so this score was not submitted.
trick-entered: Entered in this week’s trick vote.
trick-kept: You already entered a bigger trick this week.
trick-no-winner: No winner yet. Enter your best combo after a run, then vote.
trick-not-recorded: Your score has not been recorded yet. Try again in a moment.
